_note: Draft templates. Placeholders in {{double braces}} are filled from sly_data by the draft tools, so the LLM never sees the personal data. Customer-supplied placeholders are left as visible gaps for the customer to complete.

email.subject: Change of address from {{move_date}}: {{full_names}}
email.guidance: Replace {{request}} with one or two plain sentences saying exactly what this organisation should do. Keep the whole email under 120 words.

letter.subject: Change of address
letter.guidance: Replace {{request}} with the action needed, including any notice period. Keep it under 120 words.

online_form.subject: Pre-filled answers for the {{org_name}} online form
online_form.guidance: List the form fields as 'Field: {{placeholder}}' lines, one per line, using only fields this organisation needs.

phone.subject: Call script for {{org_name}}
phone.guidance: Replace {{request}} with a short phrase, for example 'move our broadband to our new address'.

direct.subject: We will update your address with us
direct.body: With your approval, we will update your address with us to {{new_address}} from {{move_date}}. You do not need to do anything else.
